content_text: I think the only real rule is ‘if it feels right’. It is hard to cut two close up shots together, of people talking to each other, if the characters are looking to the same side of camera. But that said, I see it all the time. Sometimes it doesn’t bother me but more usually it does. You can take this basic fact and expand it to a three shot or an over the shoulder and on. But, take two people in a doorway. You can’t always physically put the camera over the ‘right’ shoulder but it can work. A straight reverse. It feels right.
